name: Overlays
description: Screen bugs, lower thirds and other graphics over your channels, designed in a visual editor and timed per programme: all the way through, at the start or end, part-way through, every few minutes, or by the clock, with fades. Set them up for a whole channel or just a block, or have a block (or channel) show another channel's, kept in step. Needs ErsatzTV Next with its graphics engine.
author: SchedularrTV
lowPowerNotice: drawing overlays is cheap, but ErsatzTV always re-encodes items that carry them, even on channels set to pass video through, and does it in software on a Pi. Use them on channels that are re-encoded anyway, rather than adding them to passed-through ones.

settings.label: Folder for drawn overlays
settings.description: Where designed overlays are saved as pictures for ErsatzTV to read. Leave empty for the plugin's own data folder; set it when ErsatzTV runs elsewhere and needs a shared folder.
